sources.detail: SEASON 2 IS LIVE - tracker needs its 12.1-live migration. All 6 live pages re-fetched from scratch by direct curl with a browser UA, HTTP 200, 63-295 KB, parsed from <table class="tier-list"> (first <td> = tier, tier-list-entry img alt = "Spec Class" matched WHOLE against the roster). RAID: 40/40 re-parsed with ZERO moves against stored - an independent confirmation of the 11:31Z run's letters, and applied. M+ STILL BLOCKED, third day: the live M+ pages publish S+ / A+ / B+ / TBD while the `icyveins` scale has five bands carrying neither S+ nor B+, and the live M+ letters are byte-identical to the icyveins-ptr list on ALL 39 placed specs (verified row by row this run) - Icy Veins has replaced its live M+ lists with its PTR list. 33 of 40 stored M+ letters would move if the scale allowed a merge (Augmentation Evoker S->B, Beast Mastery A+->C, Blood DK C->S). scales.json is the gate contract, so this stays an OWNER ESCALATION and stored M+ letters are untouched. Era-verify fails the S1 test because the pages moved FORWARD: five titles read "Patch 12.1" / "Season 2" and the raid-healer page keeps a stale 12.0.7 title over a Season-2 body (changelog "11 Aug. 2026: Updated for Midnight Season 2 launch"; body over title, per the blue-tracker precedent), so seasonVerified stays s2 on all 6 - out of the live consensus via the frozen lane, into the next-patch forecast input. published re-read per page rather than carried forward: raid DPS/tank + all three M+ 2026-08-08, raid healer 2026-08-06 by JSON-LD - agrees 6/6 with published-evidence/evidence.json. Dates were already at the run date from the 11:31Z run, so this run re-verified rather than advanced them; partial because only the raid half of the source can land.

All 3 PTR M+ pages (dps/healer/tank) fetched live, HTTP 200, 217-353 KB. Era-verified the OTHER way as this source requires: every title reads "PTR Tier List for Midnight (Patch 12.1 / Season 2)". 40/40 specs read (27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank) with ZERO tier moves against stored - no new weekly rebuild since the 2026-08-09 one, matching its Sunday 14:00 CEST cadence. Subtlety Rogue is still TBD upstream (the literal TBD row) and stays an explicit null, never omitted and never guessed (39 rated rows, floor 24). published RE-READ from the page rather than carried forward: JSON-LD dateModified 2026-08-09 on all three, agreeing 3/3 with published-evidence/evidence.json. Stored snapshot was already 2026-08-12 from the 11:31Z run of this same UTC day, so this run re-verified it rather than advancing it.

Both pages fetched live, HTTP 200 (150 KB raid / 162 KB M+), parsed from the .tier__tier blocks (tier__title = letter, img alt = "Spec Class"). 79 assignments, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves. Era: the pages still self-date "Last Updated 31st March 2026" and contain ZERO occurrences of "12.1" or "Season 2" anywhere, so seasonVerified stays s1 and Method remains one of only two live-season letter sources (with Archon) while Icy Veins and Wowhead sit ahead in s2. Vengeance DH is still absent from the RAID list upstream (39 raid rows, 40 M+) - omitted, not invented. The 9 rejected M+ strings are the dungeon tier list and the site logo, not specs. Snapshot was already at the run date from the 11:31Z run; this run re-verified it.

All 6 pages fetched with the full browser header set, HTTP 200, 72-326 KB (a UA-only fetch is Cloudflare-403 on /guide/*; r.jina.ai is dead on this path and was not tried). Tiers parsed from the embedded [tier-list=rows] BBCode - the block lives inside a JS string, so the CLOSING tag is escaped as [\/tier-list] and a regex anchored on the unescaped form matches nothing. 80 assignments, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves (yesterday's single Guardian Druid M+ B->A move holds). JSON-LD dateModified: raid DPS/healer/tank + M+ DPS 2026-08-08, M+ healer 2026-08-09, M+ tank 2026-08-11 - identical to the stored published values and agreeing 6/6 with published-evidence. All six titles read "Midnight Season 2", so seasonVerified stays s2 (season-AHEAD: out of the live consensus via the frozen lane, into the next-patch forecast input). Snapshot was already at the run date from the 11:31Z run; this run re-verified it.

All 6 aggregate pages re-parsed from the __NEXT_DATA__ script tag in raw HTML (specTierListSection.tierLists[], metric "throughput" for raid and "score" for M+, never the default popularity grouping; spec read from each entry's icon "Class-Spec"). 80 assignments, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves. Archon's own lastUpdated advanced to 2026-08-12T12:00:00Z on all six pages, but every number behind it held byte-identical (see archon-metrics), so the label moved and the cut did not - the standing rule that the parse-count column, not lastUpdated, is Archon's re-cut detector. Era: the pages still describe Season 1 content (raid selector "VS / DR / MQD", the nine S1 bosses, the eight S1 dungeons), so seasonVerified stays s1. New this run: the zone-type selector now also offers "PTR M+" - noted for the flip, not ingested.

Full re-fetch of all 9 Season-1 raid bosses (throughput) + 8 M+ dungeons (score) x 3 roles = 51 pages, 51/51 HTTP 200, 40/40 specs on every encounter = 680 tier rows (floor 440). ZERO per-encounter tier moves against stored - the 26 raid-boss moves logged at 11:31Z hold exactly. Because nothing moved, data/encounter-tiers.json was left byte-identical with asOf 2026-08-11 (Archon's own cut date) rather than re-stamped to today's label date; the page snapshot this requirement measures was already at the run date and is re-verified by the 51/51 fetch.

The survivability tierList re-parsed from the same three raid aggregate pages (metric "survivability" specifically, not the default popularity grouping): 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 40/40 specs, 0 unmatched. ZERO tiers moved against stored, so nothing was re-merged and spec.survivability keeps asOf 2026-08-11; the page snapshot was already at the run date from the 11:31Z run and is re-verified by this full re-parse.

"95th pct DPS (Mythic)" re-read from __NEXT_DATA__ specRankingsSection.table.data[] (NOT tierList, which carries letters only) on the raid DPS + raid tank pages = 33 rows with n = each spec's parse count. NO RE-CUT THIS RUN: all 33 values AND all 40 raid parse counts are byte-identical to stored (Frost Mage 177412 / 22611 parses, Augmentation Evoker 187213), the mirror image of the 11:31Z run where every value and every parse count moved. Archon's lastUpdated label DID advance to 2026-08-12T12:00:00Z, but re-stamping an unchanged cut with a fresher date is exactly the failure the bloodmallet/wowmeta asOf rule exists to prevent, so nothing was merged and the rows stay at 2026-08-11 (1 day, maxAgeDays 5). Partial for that reason.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)" re-read from the raid healer page's specRankingsSection hps column = 7/7 healer specs with n = parses. All 7 values and all 7 parse counts byte-identical to stored (Mistweaver Monk 221621, Restoration Shaman 190071), so nothing was re-merged and the rows stay at Archon's own 2026-08-11. Emitted as its own row rather than folded into archon-metrics so a failure of one series can never be hidden by the other. Partial because no new cut arrived, not because the parse failed.

"M+ score (95th pct)" re-read from the three M+ pages' specRankingsSection score column: 40/40 specs parsed cleanly, and ALL 40 values AND ALL 40 parse counts are byte-identical to stored for the second consecutive run (Augmentation Evoker 4256 / 93078 parses at the top). The M+ pages' lastUpdated label advanced again, to 2026-08-12T12:00:00Z, while the data behind it did not move a byte - the parse-count column remains the only reliable re-cut detector on Archon. Rows stay at 2026-08-10 (2 days, maxAgeDays 5).

80 rows parsed (40 raid + 40 M+) from specRankingsSection.table.data[].popularity as fraction x 100. Both halves are byte-identical to stored at the stored 1-decimal precision this run - including the raid half that re-cut at 11:31Z (Blood DK 32.0, Holy Paladin 14.7, Frost Mage 9.9) - so nothing was re-merged. The family's coverage date is the unchanged M+ half at 2026-08-10, which is what previousAsOf/newAsOf report; partial for that reason.

Fetched via the JSON API only, never the stale S3 HTML prerender: data.wowmeta.com/manifest.json + /rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json, plain curl, HTTP 200, 161 KB. Selected categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} AND sortField == lowerBound AND keyRange undefined - a WHITELIST, so the melee/ranged subsets cannot double-count the 27 DPS specs - giving exactly 27+7+6 = 40 rows, classSpec names byte-identical to the roster. UPSTREAM HAS NOT RE-RUN: manifest.snapshotDate still 2026-08-11 (pipeline completedAt 2026-08-11T22:52:39Z) and all 40 lowerBound values plus all 40 numberOfCharacters byte-identical to stored, so nothing was merged. asOf is the SOURCE's snapshotDate per the standing rule, never the run date, which is why this is partial at 1 day old rather than a success claim.

This agent holds NO Warcraft Logs credentials and fetched nothing from warcraftlogs.com by any means - no API, no HTML, no proxy. Its only WCL input is wcl-fetch/evidence.json from the deterministic pre-agent step (attemptedAt 2026-08-12T20:31:35Z), whose verdict is "rdps-broken": characterRankings(metric: rdps) on encounter 3176 returns a bare "Internal server error" at HTTP 200 while OAuth and GraphQL transport are both healthy (rate limit 3600/h, 1 point spent this hour). evidence.landed carries no entry for this key. The redistributed-credit metric family is still broken upstream, so "Median rDPS (Mythic, all bosses[, tank])", "Median HPS (Mythic, all bosses)" and "Median DPS (Mythic, healer)" stay frozen at their stored 2026-08-10 values, unchanged (47 rows). The dps-family numbers that DO work were not substituted under the rDPS-labeled series (honest source typing).

Also landed by the deterministic step: evidence.landed["wcl-ptr-raid-raw"] = 27 rows built and 27 applied, pooled over the six Venomous Abyss encounters that carry parses (Nek'zali the Soulcoiler 370 ranked players, Entombed Sentinels 363, Vashnik the Malignant 678, The Lost Explorers 150, Sszorak 184, The Twin Fangs 146; The Coiled Altar and Ula'tek both 0, which is an unopened testing window rather than an error). Stored as "Median raw DPS (12.1 PTR Venomous Abyss, pooled)", era ptr, at 2026-08-12.

Also landed by the deterministic step: evidence.landed["wcl-ptr-mplus-raw"] = 27 rows built and 27 applied, pooled over all 8 Season-2 PTR dungeons at 2000 ranked players each (Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, Kings' Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss, The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena). Stored as "Median raw DPS (12.1 PTR M+ keys, pooled)", era ptr, at 2026-08-12.

All three meta pages (dps/healer/tank M+) fetched by plain GET, HTTP 200, 41-71 KB - never r.jina.ai, which does not work on murlok. 40/40 specs parsed, 0 unmatched, and every one of the 40 "Top-50 avg M+ rating (ceiling)" values is unchanged since the 11:31Z run, which recorded the season-boundary collapse (Fire Mage 3179, Protection Warrior 3557). PARSER GOTCHA FOUND AND FIXED, recorded for the next run: murlok's <a> attribute order is not stable - most cards are <a class="... meta-item ..." href=...> but several are <a href=... class="... meta-item ...">, so a regex anchored on class="[^\"]*meta-item silently dropped 4 specs (Subtlety Rogue, Elemental Shaman, Arms Warrior, Discipline Priest) while looking like a clean 36-row parse; the tell is a gap in the rank column (1,2,3,5,...). Merged at the run date; murlok publishes no snapshot date of its own. Page titles still read "Season 1" while the body says "Patch 12.1".

BLOODMALLET HAS RE-SIMMED FOR SEASON 2 AND THE NEW CHARTS WERE DELIBERATELY NOT INGESTED. All 27 DPS specs requested from talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with up to 4 retries each; 26 charts returned (Augmentation Evoker gave the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body on all 4 tries - the documented genuine absence). 14 of the 26 now carry simc_settings.tier == "MID2" with their own timestamp 2026-08-12 (both DKs, all three Hunters, all three Mages, Shadow Priest, Subtlety Rogue, both damage Shamans, Affliction and Destruction Warlock); the other 12 are still MID1 and byte-identical to stored at 2026-07-08. The MID2 values sit on a different footing entirely - Frost DK 1T 133933 -> 219211, 8T 391980 -> 1001606, roughly 1.7-2.3x across the board - and fightProfile labels are WITHIN-ROLE PERCENTILES across DPS specs, so merging 14 MID2 vectors into a pool of 12 MID1 ones would make every ST/cleave/AoE label an artifact of which specs Bloodmallet has re-simmed rather than of spec strength. The skill's "confirm tier == MID1" check is exactly this era gate, so nothing was written and the 26 stored profiles stay whole and internally comparable at 2026-07-08 coverage (35 days against maxAgeDays 5 - the red heartbeat is the correct signal). The MID2 set is a one-shot re-harvest for the 12.1-live migration, not a per-spec drip.

MID1_Raid.html re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 37.2 MB. Its own header still reads "Timestamp: 2026-08-08 07:28:33+0000", SimulationCraft 1205-01 for 12.0.7.68974 (hotfix 2026-08-06/68974, git build 678e66d384) - the SAME completed report as the last four runs, so there is no re-sim to ingest. Verified rather than assumed: ALL 26 stored "SimC nightly Patchwerk DPS" values reproduce EXACTLY out of the DPS-ranking chart's own data block (method note: take the data[] array enclosing the FIRST big-value MID1_* series - a max over every series in the file picks up the later "Damage per Second (Click title for burst)" charts and disagrees with every stored value; that is what produced yesterday's 24-of-26). 26 stored rows unchanged at 2026-08-08 (4 days, maxAgeDays 10).

Fetched DIRECTLY, HTTP 200, 187 KB (/period/latest 302s to the period page; r.jina.ai was not needed and its condensed markdown is not trustworthy for per-spec attribution). Still period 1075, MID1, 10000 characters / 3247 unique - no new weekly period, as expected days before Season 2 opens. 35 spec values parsed (class% x spec%) and every one is byte-identical to what the 11:31Z run stored, so the re-merge was a no-op and the family's coverage date holds at the run date. BEAST MASTERY HUNTER HAS NOW DROPPED OFF THE PAGE, taking the absent set to five (also Vengeance DH, Restoration Druid, Devastation Evoker, Protection Paladin): a legitimate upstream zero-representation absence in the last week of Season 1, not a parse miss - its stored row keeps its older date rather than being forced to today, which is what keeps the family's coverage date honest.

No new build to log - the feed is unchanged at 15 entries, newest still the 2026-08-06 launch patch notes. All three channels checked. (1) Official thread 2317811.json: posts_count 17, highest_post_number still 19 (Linxy, 2026-07-31T23:42Z), nothing after the two 07-31 posts already logged as builds #18/#19; with 12.1 shipped the thread is effectively closed for this cycle. (2) Wowhead news RSS: 40 items spanning 2026-08-07..2026-08-12, bodies read out of content:encoded in a single fetch; ZERO change-verb hits across all 40 - the six items new since the 11:31Z run are live-service (Blinding Vale/Temple scenario bugs, a bugged Zul'jarra contract, hero-gear and Renown-reward explainers, Vaults of Atal'Utek, sparks). (3) Wowhead blue tracker (/blue-tracker?rss with the FULL browser header set - a UA-only fetch is CloudFront-403 and reads as an empty feed): 50 items back to 08-06, the only two mentioning hotfixes are Bob the Bartender and lair-queue grouping, and there is NO standalone class-tuning blue post of the Kaivax "Healer Tuning" shape. No tier-set line landed, so no spec.tierSet upkeep was due. Writeup coverage stays 39/40: Demonology Warlock's ptr: null was RE-CONFIRMED from Icy Veins' rebuilt Season-2 raid page, which says the spec "received no changes going to Season 2, with the only new feature added being their tier-set" - "nothing changed" is not a verdict, so no writeup was manufactured. Blizzard's own post still puts Season 2 at August 18 (NA) / 19 August (EU), inside PHASE_FLIP_DUE 2026-08-20.

TRANSCRIPT API KEY problem: limit-exceeded. transcript-fetch/summary.json (2026-08-12T20:35:12Z) reports verdict "limit-exceeded" on the single video it attempted (bqVHzvKJCuA), 1 requested / 0 fetched, "stopped early ... remaining queue untouched" - Supadata's free tier is 100 requests per MONTH and the budget is spent. No transcript was readable, so ZERO takes and ZERO metaNotes were added, changed or superseded; this agent fetched nothing from YouTube or any transcript API by any means. DISCOVERY was completed in full: all 44 unique channels polled (74 transcribable creator entries collapse to 41 distinct channels, plus 3 generalCreators), 44/44 HTTP 200, 0 RSS failures, 660 videos enumerated, diffed against a 946-id seen-set built from structured data only (pending seen[] + skipped[] + videos[], union every youtu.be id in a take or metaNote). 10 unseen videos, all published today and all inside the 12.1 cycle; the nightly keyword filter was KEPT per the monthly-budget rule and 9 were queued to data/pending-transcripts.json, taking the queue to 15 - including NeekapHere's "Retribution Paladin DPS Guide (PvE) Midnight 12.1", the one worth draining first since Retribution Paladin is one of three specs with no raid-scoped take at all. The single video not queued (Critcake, "Patch day! Short afternoon stream :)") carries no class/spec/12.1/Season signal; as this morning it was NOT written into seen[], because a nightly budget dismissal must not hide a video from the local unfiltered sweep that is supposed to reconsider it. generalCreators[].latest was left unchanged on purpose: those fields hold distilled one-line reads, not bare titles, and overwriting them without a transcript would trade information for recency. Partial because the distil half of the skill could not run at all; a local yt-dlp catch-up run would clear the queue for free.
